description: Configure the 'Enterprise Cloud Adoption 2024' survey for integration with the 'TechSample Solutions' panel provider. You must: 1) Add a URL parameter named 'rid' to the survey. 2) Set the survey's End URL to 'https://api.techsample.com/complete?project=9982&rid={PASSTHRU:rid}' and enable auto-loading. 3) Create a quota named 'Screenout: Non-Decision Makers' for question Q01 that immediately terminates the survey (limit 0) if the answer is 'No'. 4) Configure this quota to auto-load the termination URL: 'https://api.techsample.com/term?project=9982&rid={PASSTHRU:rid}'. Login with admin/Admin123!.
